messages:
Priya: FYI vendor reported a pricing experiment — they blended preemptible + on-demand GPU rates retroactively for a week. We're seeing a $9.1k delta on July invoices. Thoughts?

cost-bot: ALERT: Vendor billing variance detected (2024-09-02). Invoice delta: +$9,120 vs expected. Affected tags: customer=acme, team=ml & untagged sandbox clusters.

Maya: Ouch. Is the delta applied across all projects or only certain SKUs?

Omar: Early look: it's applied to preemptible SKU hours where the vendor decided to bill at blended price instead of advertised preemptible discount. BigQuery join shows most impact on long-running training jobs and on sandbox spin-ups that used mixed instance types. Query: SELECT sku, project_id, SUM(cost_diff) ...

Kai: Vendor told us it was an "experiment" and they gave API flag to opt out, but it was toggled after the billing window. We need to decide reclassification policy and whether to dispute.

Priya: Risk: if we dispute, vendor may require proof of instance type / preemptible flag at runtime. Ops, can you provide instance-level logs?

Kai: We can export instance metadata and preemptible flag for the month; however sandbox ephemeral instances sometimes don't persist metadata correctly. Expect gaps.

Maya: For allocation: some of the delta is on customer-tagged projects (acme) ~ $3.6k and rest internal/sandbox ~ $5.5k. Proposal: escalate customer portion with vendor and absorb sandbox portion as internal credit for this cycle.

Omar: Agreed. For customer items, generate evidence pack: instance IDs, start/end, provisioning logs, and customer contract clauses. I'll run the ambiguous-instance join and produce CSV.

Priya: Approval rules: I'll approve vendor dispute for customer-affecting > $1k. For sandbox/internal amounts <= $10k finance will absorb once ops verifies it's not customer usage. Above that we escalate to CFO+legal.

Kai: I'll start exports and tag any missing metadata with a placeholder 'missing_meta' so we can highlight gaps. Will also patch provisioning templates to enforce preemptible flag parity.

Maya: Action items: Omar to produce CSV for customer-tagged delta (EOD), Kai to export instance metadata and list gaps (EOD), Priya to sign off on dispute for customer portion once CSV posted. Cost-bot: schedule nightly diff job to catch retro billing experiments.

cost-bot: SCHEDULE: Retro-billing-diff-run set for 03:30 UTC nightly.

Priya: Keep updates in this thread. If vendor won't reclassify customer items within 7 days, finance opens dispute.

Maya: Noted. I'll prepare a short memo for affected customers and sales so they get a heads-up if we pass on any changes. :memo:
